p13/esc410:1.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:1.text: I've been better. I just buried my dog yesterday

p13/esc410:10.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:10.text: Was that your only pet? Or do you have others? We moved from FL to KY and the little dog just hung out here, he really belonged to the neighbor's son who didn't want him, so he just ran around wild and wouldn't leave. I never had a dog, but it got cold, so i took him in. They never asked about him and after a week, I asked them if I could have the dog, so they said yes. I don't think they cared.

p13/esc410:11.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:11.text: I wish I could give you a hug, really, there are no words to make this better as you already know the grief of losing a pet, it does get better, but it stings terribly at first.

p13/esc410:12.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:12.text: I have 2 other dogs that are mine and my boyfriend has 2

p13/esc410:13.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:13.text: Thank you. that means a lot

p13/esc410:14.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:14.text: We both had dogs when we met.

p13/esc410:15.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:15.text: So you definitely are a dog lover! I was in my 50s before I ever had a dog, now I wish I had more, they are really loving. Not like cats who don't care much about much except FOOD! lol

p13/esc410:16.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:16.text: I know when tragedy happens, I can't get stuck in depression, I sort of have to force myself to put one foot in front of the other. It's hard to have a healthy balance between grieving and continuing to live. Cry, then dry my eyes, pick up, go for a walk, don't get caught in grief, but yet don't deny it!

p13/esc410:17.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:17.text: They get to be so close and you can really pick up on their emotions and stuff. That's what happens to me. I get stuck sometimes

p13/esc410:18.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:18.text: I get stuck too. But you are doing the right things, here you reached out to someone and I do care, so you are moving forward.

p13/esc410:19.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:19.text: I always find it helpful just so have someone share my pain with me. Just to know I'm  not alone.

p13/esc410:2.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:2.text: She was going to turn 15 next month

p13/esc410:20.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:20.text: Thanks. Another person who has pets helps

p13/esc410:22.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:22.text: I do understand. My mom died in 2010, right after she died, 1 of my cats died, my husband went into the hospital and almost died, so we went on vacation so I would not be consumed with grief, and do you know, we brought our pets and our cat died when we arrived here on vacation?  I will never forget that. You know what. I knew I could either get consumed in grief, or push through. Man, that was hard. I prayed a lot and God got me through that and I had a good vacation, all things considered.

p13/esc410:23.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:23.text: I will definitely pray for you too that God will comfort your heart and that you will be comforted by your other dogs and your boyfriend's dogs and that you will feel joy at times at the happy memories you had with your dog.

p13/esc410:24.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:24.text: Oh wow, that sounds horrible. Pushing through though I guess is all one can do then. Thank you so much. I believe in prayer.

p13/esc410:25.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:25.text: Prayer is what gets me through every day!  :D  It was rough, but I believe these hard times strengthen us in some way. Because life throws hard balls, and we have to move forward or be consumed.

p13/esc410:26.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:26.text: That's true. I'm glad I did this project. You really helped me.

p13/esc410:27.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:27.text: I'm so glad I did too. It was a pleasure to meet you. And once again, (hug). :D

p13/esc410:28.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:28.text: You too. Thanks so much. bye

p13/esc410:29.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:29.text: I have one more thing to say - wise words from this 92 year old lady at church named Sue. She told me this after my brother died. When you get older, everyone you know is practically dead.  She said "Life is for the living, if you get caught up to much in all the death, you won't life."  True words. God bless, have a good night.

p13/esc410:3.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:3.text: Ouch! I'm so sorry to hear that. I never lost a dog, but I've lost cats.

p13/esc410:4.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:4.text: Is 14 a good age for a dog?

p13/esc410:5.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:5.text: I have my first dog so I don't know much, he is 9 years old and came with our house.

p13/esc410:6.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:6.text: Actually, yes. She was old and had dementia.

p13/esc410:7.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:7.text: The oldest dog I evet had was 15

p13/esc410:8.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:8.text: I'm so sorry, losing a pet is very hard on us.

p13/esc410:9.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:9.text: How did your dog come with the house?

p13/esc585:0.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:0.text: HI there, how are you doing?

p13/esc585:10.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:10.text: Ha, well that could get interesting

p13/esc585:12.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:12.text: anyway, thanks for the chat. this was helpful

p13/esc585:2.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:2.text: Do you want to talk about whats going on right now?

p13/esc585:3.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:3.text: Sure. I took a nude photo of myself to share with someone I'm dating, and accidentally sent it to several friends in a group chat

p13/esc585:4.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:4.text: I'm really embarrassed about it and I have some anxiety about meeting or talking to my friends

p13/esc585:5.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:5.text: Ive done some things like that before. I know this might sound weird but what helped me through it was to actually own it. Take control of it before they can.

p13/esc585:6.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:6.text: Do you think it would be helpful to use humor? I don't want them to tease me about it but I don't know how else to approach it

p13/esc585:7.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:7.text: Yea that is definitely one way to control it

p13/esc585:8.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:8.text: Lol maybe some of my friends will share with the group too

p13/esc585:9.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:9.text: that would definitely make me feel better about it

p13/p13_conv_11:0.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_11:0.text: Hi Linda, how have you been doing lately?

p13/p13_conv_11:1.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_11:1.text: Hey, I've been having a tough time recently. I've started having recurring dreams about my late dog.

p13/p13_conv_11:2.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_11:2.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. It sounds like it must be hard for you. How do these dreams make you feel?

p13/p13_conv_11:3.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_11:3.text: It's bittersweet. In the dreams, I'm always so happy to see him, but when I wake up, the loss hits all over again.

p13/p13_conv_11:4.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_11:4.text: That makes a lot of sense. Grief can be so tricky and overwhelming. Do you remember specific moments in the dreams that stand out?

p13/p13_conv_11:5.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_11:5.text: Yes, it's always us playing in the park or snuggling on the couch. They were such ordinary moments but meant the world to me.

p13/p13_conv_11:6.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_11:6.text: Those memories hold a lot of meaning. It's understandable they manifest in your dreams. Do you think there might be something triggering this pattern?

p13/p13_conv_11:7.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_11:7.text: I wonder if it's because I've been feeling stressed with the wedding planning and work. Maybe Max symbolized comfort for me.

p13/p13_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:0.text: Hi Linda, how have you been feeling lately?

p13/p13_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:1.text: Hey. Honestly, it's been a tough week. Losing Max still feels so raw.

p13/p13_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:10.text: That can definitely be challenging. What do you think is making it hard to accept his support?

p13/p13_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:11.text: I guess I've always been independent. Relying on someone else feels foreign to me.

p13/p13_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:12.text: That makes sense. Sometimes accepting support is part of growing together. It can be a way to strengthen your bond.

p13/p13_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:13.text: You're right, and I do appreciate him being here. It's a learning process for both of us.

p13/p13_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:14.text: Absolutely. It's important to give yourself grace during this time.

p13/p13_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:15.text: I appreciate that. Talking about Max and his wagging tail makes me smile, even if it's bittersweet.

p13/p13_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:16.text: Those memories can be quite comforting. Maybe you and David can create a little tribute to Max?

p13/p13_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:17.text: That's a beautiful idea. I think it might help me honor his memory positively.

p13/p13_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:18.text: I'm glad you think so. Remember, it's okay to grieve and to find comforting ways to remember Max.

p13/p13_conv_1:19.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:19.text: Thank you for your support. This conversation has really helped me see things from a different perspective.

p13/p13_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:2.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. It sounds like Max meant a lot to you.

p13/p13_conv_1:20.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:20.text: You're welcome, Linda. I'm here for you anytime you need to talk.

p13/p13_conv_1:21.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:21.text: I appreciate that a lot. I'll talk to David about your suggestion tonight.

p13/p13_conv_1:22.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:22.text: Great. I'm sure it'll be a meaningful and healing experience for both of you.

p13/p13_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:3.text: He really did. Max was more than just a pet; he was part of the family.

p13/p13_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:4.text: I can imagine it's like a part of your daily life is missing now. How are you coping?

p13/p13_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:5.text: It helps that David moved in. It's comforting not to be alone in the apartment.

p13/p13_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:6.text: That's good to hear. Having David around must provide some relief. How is the adjustment going?

p13/p13_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:7.text: It's good, but I feel guilty sometimes. Like I'm burdening him with my grief.

p13/p13_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:8.text: It's understandable to feel that way, but remember, it's okay to lean on someone you trust.

p13/p13_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:9.text: Yeah, he keeps saying he wants to be there for me, but I'm still struggling to accept help.

p13/p13_conv_2:0.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:0.text: Hi Linda, how are you holding up today?

p13/p13_conv_2:1.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:1.text: Hey, I'm not doing too great. I had a big argument with Lily about family stuff.

p13/p13_conv_2:10.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:10.text: Guilt can be so tough to deal with. But remember, you're only human. You're allowed to set boundaries and take care of yourself.

p13/p13_conv_2:11.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:11.text: I know, but it's hard to shake off. I want things to be okay between Lily and me.

p13/p13_conv_2:12.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:12.text: I understand. It shows how much you care about your relationship with her. Have you thought about how you might approach things with Lily moving forward?

p13/p13_conv_2:13.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:13.text: I've been thinking of reaching out and talking it over calmly. I don't want this to become a bigger issue.

p13/p13_conv_2:14.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:14.text: That sounds like a really thoughtful approach. Clear communication might help both of you understand each other better.

p13/p13_conv_2:15.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:15.text: I hope so. I just hate being in this kind of conflict. It feels exhausting.

p13/p13_conv_2:16.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:16.text: Conflicts can be really draining, but resolving them can also lead to stronger bonds. You're strong for facing it head-on.

p13/p13_conv_2:17.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:17.text: Thanks for saying that. I guess I'll try to focus on the good side of it.

p13/p13_conv_2:18.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:18.text: Absolutely. Lean on David too; he's there to support you. How are things going with him?

p13/p13_conv_2:19.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:19.text: He's been great, actually. Moving in together has been a big help for me emotionally, especially after losing my dog.

p13/p13_conv_2:2.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. It must be hard having a fight with someone close to you. What happened, if you feel like sharing?

p13/p13_conv_2:20.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:20.text: It's wonderful to hear you have that support. David seems like a solid rock for you during tough times.

p13/p13_conv_2:21.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:21.text: Yeah, he's been amazing. I think I'll talk to him more about how I'm feeling too.

p13/p13_conv_2:22.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:22.text: That's a good idea. Keeping him in the loop can only strengthen your relationship.

p13/p13_conv_2:23.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:23.text: I'll definitely do that. Thanks for listening to me today, it really helps to talk things out.

p13/p13_conv_2:24.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:24.text: Anytime, Linda. I'm here whenever you need to chat. You're doing great, just take it one step at a time.

p13/p13_conv_2:3.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:3.text: We've always had different views on family responsibilities, but this time it got really heated. She thinks I'm not doing enough.

p13/p13_conv_2:4.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:4.text: That sounds really stressful. It must be tough feeling like your efforts aren't recognized.

p13/p13_conv_2:5.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:5.text: Yeah, exactly. I'm trying to help as much as I can, especially with work being so demanding.

p13/p13_conv_2:6.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:6.text: Balancing work and family can be really challenging. You're doing your best, and it sounds like you're being stretched thin.

p13/p13_conv_2:7.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:7.text: I just feel overwhelmed sometimes. I want to be there for my family but also need to take care of myself.

p13/p13_conv_2:8.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:8.text: It's completely understandable to feel that way. It's important to find a balance that works for you, too.

p13/p13_conv_2:9.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:9.text: Then there’s the guilt. I keep thinking about how maybe I should be doing more.

p13/p13_conv_3:0.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:0.text: Hey, I could really use someone to talk to right now. Mind lending an ear?

p13/p13_conv_3:1.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:1.text: Of course, Linda. I'm here for you. What's on your mind?

p13/p13_conv_3:10.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:10.text: Well, he’s full of energy and brings some chaos into my routine, which is a nice distraction. But sometimes, I feel overwhelmed trying to train him.

p13/p13_conv_3:11.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:11.text: It sounds like he's bringing some lively energy into your life, but it's okay to feel overwhelmed. It's a big adjustment for both of you.

p13/p13_conv_3:12.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:12.text: Exactly. And with David moving in, I worry about how all these changes are affecting us.

p13/p13_conv_3:13.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:13.text: That's a lot to juggle. How's your relationship with David? Is he supportive with all these changes?

p13/p13_conv_3:14.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:14.text: David's been wonderful. Having him here helps, but I fear I'm relying on him too much.

p13/p13_conv_3:15.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:15.text: It's great that David is there for support. It's okay to lean on him during tough times, as long as you communicate and find balance together.

p13/p13_conv_3:16.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:16.text: I'll keep that in mind. I just need to find my own footing amidst everything that's happening.

p13/p13_conv_3:17.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:17.text: You will. You're taking steps by adopting a new puppy and being honest about your feelings. It shows strength and courage.

p13/p13_conv_3:18.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:18.text: Thanks for saying that. It's just been a whirlwind lately, and I appreciate having someone to talk it through with.

p13/p13_conv_3:19.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:19.text: Anytime, Linda. Remember, it's okay to feel however you feel right now. You're doing an amazing job taking care of yourself and embracing change.

p13/p13_conv_3:2.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:2.text: I just adopted a new puppy, and while I thought it would help, I’m feeling all sorts of things I didn’t expect.

p13/p13_conv_3:3.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:3.text: Adopting a new puppy sounds like a big step. What feelings are coming up for you?

p13/p13_conv_3:4.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:4.text: I thought it would ease the pain of losing Max. But sometimes, it feels like I'm trying to replace him.

p13/p13_conv_3:5.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:5.text: Losing Max was really tough on you. It's understandable to have mixed emotions. It's okay to miss him while also making room for new love.

p13/p13_conv_3:6.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:6.text: Thank you for saying that. I just feel guilty, like I'm betraying Max's memory by loving another dog.

p13/p13_conv_3:7.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:7.text: Guilt is a common feeling, but remember, Max would want you to be happy and give love to another dog. You're not replacing him; you're honoring the love you shared by opening your heart again.

p13/p13_conv_3:8.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_3:8.text: I know, logically, you’re right. I guess it's just my heart struggling to catch up.

p13/p13_conv_3:9.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_3:9.text: That's completely normal, Linda. Healing takes time, and you're doing your best. How is the new puppy helping, if at all?

p13/p13_conv_4:0.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:0.text: Hi Linda, how are you feeling today?

p13/p13_conv_4:1.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:1.text: Hey, I'm feeling pretty overwhelmed at the moment.

p13/p13_conv_4:10.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:10.text: I can imagine that makes it hard to decompress. Perhaps finding small moments in the day for yourself could help, even if it's just a few minutes.

p13/p13_conv_4:11.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:11.text: That might be worth trying. Maybe a short walk with Buddy could help clear my head.

p13/p13_conv_4:12.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:12.text: That sounds like a wonderful idea. Buddy would probably love that too!

p13/p13_conv_4:13.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:13.text: Yeah, he probably would. I also think I need to re-evaluate how I'm handling work stress. This panic attack was a wake-up call.

p13/p13_conv_4:14.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:14.text: It's impressive that you're reflecting on this and considering changes. Recognizing the need for balance is such a big step.

p13/p13_conv_4:15.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:15.text: Thank you. I really appreciate the encouragement. I also need to find a way to mend things with Lily. Our argument has been weighing on me too.

p13/p13_conv_4:16.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:16.text: Family dynamics can be challenging, especially after a disagreement. It's understandable you're feeling down about it.

p13/p13_conv_4:17.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:17.text: Yeah, I hope I can find a way to apologize and move forward. I've been hesitant to reach out.

p13/p13_conv_4:18.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:18.text: Taking the first step can be daunting, but it could lead to healing for both of you. Maybe just starting with a message to say you miss her could open the door.

p13/p13_conv_4:19.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:19.text: That's a good idea. I'll try to write her something sincere. I really hope we can patch things up.

p13/p13_conv_4:2.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like to share what's been going on?

p13/p13_conv_4:20.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:20.text: Your willingness to reconcile shows just how much you value your relationship with her. I'm hopeful for you both.

p13/p13_conv_4:21.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:21.text: Thanks. It means a lot to have someone to talk to about all this. I'm feeling a bit more hopeful now.

p13/p13_conv_4:22.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:22.text: I'm glad to hear that, Linda. Remember, I'm here whenever you need to talk. You've got this!

p13/p13_conv_4:3.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:3.text: It's been a lot at work. The pressure has really been getting to me lately, and I actually had a panic attack a few days ago.

p13/p13_conv_4:4.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:4.text: That sounds really tough. Panic attacks can be so frightening. Have you been able to talk to anyone about it?

p13/p13_conv_4:5.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:5.text: I mentioned it to David. He's been there for me, but sometimes I feel like it's unfair to burden him with my issues.

p13/p13_conv_4:6.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:6.text: It's great that David is supportive, but remember, your feelings and experiences are valid, and it's okay to lean on him during tough times.

p13/p13_conv_4:7.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:7.text: Thank you. I just wish I could manage my stress better. I thought adopting Buddy would help, but I still find myself feeling anxious.

p13/p13_conv_4:8.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_4:8.text: Pets can be comforting, but it's understandable to still feel anxious, especially with work pressures piling up. Have you had a chance to take any breaks or do something relaxing lately?

p13/p13_conv_4:9.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_4:9.text: Not really. The deadlines are so tight, and I'm constantly worried about falling behind.

p13/p13_conv_5:0.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:0.text: Hey Linda! How have you been holding up since deciding to take some time off work?

p13/p13_conv_5:1.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:1.text: Hi. It's been a mix of emotions honestly. It feels strange not to be in the office, but I know I need this break.

p13/p13_conv_5:10.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:10.text: Absolutely, those little moments can be quite powerful. Is there anything else you've found helpful during this time to manage your stress?

p13/p13_conv_5:11.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:11.text: I've started journaling a bit. I think putting my thoughts on paper helps me process them better. Plus, it helps distract me from worrying about work.

p13/p13_conv_5:12.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:12.text: That sounds like a great way to process emotions. Writing can be so cathartic. Have you been able to reach any new insights about your situation through journaling?

p13/p13_conv_5:13.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:13.text: I guess I've realized that I need to set clearer boundaries. I tend to take on too much, and it eventually gets overwhelming.

p13/p13_conv_5:14.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:14.text: That’s a very important realization, Linda. Setting boundaries can be challenging, but it’s crucial for your mental health. Have you thought about any specific steps you can take to start creating those boundaries when you return to work?

p13/p13_conv_5:15.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:15.text: I’m considering having a talk with my manager about my workload. Mike has been understanding in the past, and I'm hopeful he'll support a more manageable schedule.

p13/p13_conv_5:16.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:16.text: It sounds like a rational plan and I’m glad you’re thinking of discussing this with Mike. Remember, advocating for yourself is key. How have things been with Lily lately? Any better since your last conversation?

p13/p13_conv_5:17.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:17.text: We’ve had a couple of talks since the argument. It’s still a bit tense, but I think we’re starting to understand each other more. It’ll take time, but I’m hopeful.

p13/p13_conv_5:18.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:18.text: That’s a good start, and it’s great that you’re both taking steps towards reconciliation. It’s important to be patient with each other. Anything else on your mind that you'd like to share?

p13/p13_conv_5:19.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:19.text: Not at the moment. Just trying to take things one day at a time. Thanks for listening, it really helps to talk about these things.

p13/p13_conv_5:2.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:2.text: It's completely understandable to feel that way. Taking a pause can sometimes feel unsettling, but it's important to prioritize your wellbeing. How are you coping with everything so far?

p13/p13_conv_5:20.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:20.text: Anytime, Linda. Remember that you have support and are doing your best. Feel free to reach out whenever you need someone to talk to. Take care of yourself!

p13/p13_conv_5:3.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:3.text: I've had some good days and some not-so-good days. I've been trying to make the most of my time, but it's hard not to worry about falling behind at work.

p13/p13_conv_5:4.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:4.text: It’s only natural to feel anxious about work. Remember, you've made this decision for a reason. It's okay to focus on your health right now.

p13/p13_conv_5:5.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:5.text: You're right. I just hope I won't let my team down. I had a panic attack last month, and it really shook me.

p13/p13_conv_5:6.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:6.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, Linda. Panic attacks can be incredibly overwhelming. Have you had any more incidents since then?

p13/p13_conv_5:7.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:7.text: Thankfully, no more since then. But it’s been hard to shake the fear off. David’s been really supportive though, and Buddy has been a great distraction.

p13/p13_conv_5:8.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_5:8.text: It's wonderful to hear that David and Buddy have been comforting. Having supportive loved ones around can make such a difference. Have they been helping you with any specific strategies or just being there when you need them?

p13/p13_conv_5:9.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_5:9.text: David's been encouraging me to talk things out and we've been going for walks with Buddy, which helps me clear my mind. I guess it's the little things, you know?

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: You're right. I just hope I won't let my team down. I had a panic attack last month, and it really shook me.

spans.exact_quote: I appreciate that. Talking about Max and his wagging tail makes me smile, even if it's bittersweet.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I just adopted a new puppy, and while I thought it would help, I’m feeling all sorts of things I didn’t expect.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I thought it would ease the pain of losing Max. But sometimes, it feels like I'm trying to replace him.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Well, he’s full of energy and brings some chaos into my routine, which is a nice distraction. But sometimes, I feel overwhelmed trying to train him.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Exactly. And with David moving in, I worry about how all these changes are affecting us.

spans.speaker: seeker
